pitch_routes.route: No unsolicited submissions. Pitches must come through a licensed agent, producer, attorney, manager or industry executive who already has a relationship with Netflix.

briefs.title: Trendsetters '25: What's next for Netflix in docs and unscripted (Realscreen)
briefs.summary: Adam Del Deo: aims to be 'the leading voice in the documentary realm'; wants emotionally deep narratives, often with renowned filmmakers, borrowing narrative techniques from fiction; diverse slate. (Unscripted remarks were from Jeff Gaspin, who has since left.)

briefs.title: Netflix and Warner Music Group documentary deal (Music Business Worldwide)
briefs.summary: Multi-year first-look deal for music documentary films and series about WMG artists; Del Deo said music 'inspires incredible fandom on Netflix', which points to appetite for music docs.
